goal: Deepen the active-task Task Rail with an Assurance phase row and a bounded QA acceptance-progress row fed only from existing foreground update payloads, and add one /imm-tasks read-only overlay command that lists the active Managed task and every not-enrolled docs/plans/*.intent.json draft (settled history excluded) without mutating any authority state.

acceptance.assertion: The Task Rail classifies real QA progress payloads as Verifying and renders an optional Assurance phase row plus an optional QA acceptance-progress row (n/total plus latest acceptance id) fed only from existing foreground update payloads.

A /imm-tasks read-only overlay lists the active task with its projected Obligation and every valid not-enrolled docs/plans/*.intent.json draft whose task_id matches its filename (Planning state), excluding task IDs with terminal tombstones while isolating malformed filenames, sidecars, and tombstones to their own entries.

Every touched .pi-extension source file keeps the Footer empty and stays free of timer/polling sources; the complete forbidden-source scan passes and the generated Claude runtime mirror matches its shared source.
The candidate Spec exists at its lifecycle-correct active or archived path with complete metadata and Brainstorm Trace.
